svg.title: Air flow between a car and a truck
svg.desc: Seen from above, air streams past a car beside a truck. Tracers in the narrow gap move faster, so the pressure there is lower and the vehicles are pushed toward each other. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Passing a truck: faster air, lower pressure
truck
car
Air speeds up in the gap
→ lower pressure there
Red: net push toward the gap
v ∝ 1 / gap width
Viewed from above, in the vehicles’ frame: air streams past
Tracers in the narrow gap move 2.3 times faster to carry the same flow. Bernoulli: the faster stream
has lower pressure, so the vehicles are pushed together.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
